findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "v1" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bsp, pscale_pool_engage, pscale_networking, pscale_play · Private data: bsp, pscale_settle, pscale_key_publish, pscale_verify_rider, pscale_networking, pscale_play · Public sink: pscale_key_publish, pscale_pool_engage, pscale_networking · Destructive: pscale_networking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bsp, pscale_pool_engage, pscale_networking, pscale_play · Private data: bsp, pscale_settle, pscale_key_publish, pscale_verify_rider, pscale_networking, pscale_play · Public sink: pscale_key_publish, pscale_pool_engage, pscale_networking · Destructive: pscale_networking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
